text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"multi-paragraph argument with \"Initially,\" \"Secondly,\" and \"However,\"","quality":"organization","description":"The essay presents ideas in a clearer sequence with paragraphing and transitions that guide the reader through the argument."},{"evidence":"\"would be an encouragement to cheating\" and \"could be helpful and very easy to set up\"","quality":"development","description":"The essay develops its claims with more extended explanation and multiple supporting points rather than brief unsupported remarks."},{"evidence":"\"many would get even more distracted than they already are\" and \"this would then encourage cheating\"","quality":"reasoning","description":"The essay shows stronger cause-and-effect reasoning by connecting the policy to specific consequences."},{"evidence":"\"cellular devices should not be allowed during educational time\" and \"I strongly disagree\"","quality":"clarity of stance","description":"The essay states its position more clearly and maintains that position consistently throughout."},{"evidence":"\"not looking and paying to the teacher for more than a minute makes me loose focus\"","quality":"sentence control","description":"The essay uses longer sentences with better control of clause structure, even though there are still errors."},{"evidence":"\"cellphones would draw too much of student's attention\" and \"everyone knows the reason he is almost failing\"","quality":"word choice","description":"The essay uses more precise academic vocabulary and more natural phrasing overall."}]}
